result.summary: The page appears largely well-formed with no critical or major visual defects. A few minor cosmetic inconsistencies were noted, mostly around visual consistency of restaurant card imagery and small styling details.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké card image sits on a light grey background while the neighboring cards (Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria) use dark, photographic-style backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use consistently treated imagery (similar background tone, crop, and lighting) across all carousel cards, or apply a uniform overlay/background style to card thumbnails.

issues.description: The delivery fee text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') is rendered in a light grey that has relatively low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (at least 4.5:1 for small text).

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the pizza card near the bottom sits on a semi-transparent dark circle over a busy brown image, giving it lower visibility than the same icon on the ramen card.
issues.suggestion: Increase the opacity of the icon's background scrim or add a subtle border/shadow so the favorite control remains clearly visible on all image backgrounds.
